column1: # Upstream repositories analysed for larmorx, pinned to the exact commits read on 2026-10-08/09.
# Used by scripts/bootstrap_workspace.sh. Columns are TAB-separated:
# commit: a git commit, or "sha256:<hex>" for a release tarball (downloaded, checked, unpacked)
# location: "ws"            = clone into the workspace root (read-only reference)
#           "tags"          = clone into <workspace>/tags/: the release tags code is ported from (UPSTREAM.md)
#           "reference_src" = clone into <workspace>/reference_src/ (licence review only; DO NOT READ for implementation)
# Porting must use the release tags listed in CLAUDE.md, not these master/dev snapshots.
